content: गायत्री .²1 A Vedic metre of 24 syllables; गायत्री छन्दसामहम् <ls>Bg. 10. 35</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a very sacred verse repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his Sandhyā (morning and evening devotions) and on other occasions also. Great sins even are said to be expiated by a pious repetition of this verse, which is as follows:-- तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् <ls>Rv. 3. 62. 10</ls>. .²3 A number of mystical verses in Tantra literature. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā, <ls>Ks. 53. 172</ls>. .{@-त्रम्@} A hymn composed and recited in the Gāyatrī metre.
